_comment: 305-station x 20-epoch SMOKE for the two traces landed 2026-08-14 (QUEUE item 4 / 8).
PURPOSE: wiring + COST at scale.  NOT a grading run - 20 epochs is 10 minutes and is
entirely inside ignition, where r_i ramps 0.0000 -> ~0.52 and epoch-median s_raw runs
0.836 -> 1.816 on the 24-sta arm.  Do NOT read a variance factor, a flag rate or an
iono error off this run (CLAUDE.md 'never verdict in ignition').
Base: _golden0729_net305_3h_smoke.json - chosen because the post-fit RAIM seam is
LIVE there (raim && phase_leveling).  The _agu305_gps_smoke / _ft63 chain arms neither
phase_leveling nor raim_carry_invariant, so carry_warm || raim_ci_on is FALSE, the RAIM
seam never runs, and both new traces would have been EMPTY files.
ARMED here, explicitly rather than by flipping loader defaults (standing directive
feedback_no_knob_promotion_step: 'keep defaults untouched - the ledger recommends, the
loader reports, the user decides'):
network.trace_raim_redundancy   - the per-row/per-SIGNAL Baarda r_i census, the cost
being measured.  573 rows/epoch at 24 sta (+17% wall);
this run measures the 305-sta per-epoch cost before
anyone arms it on a multi-hour run (~2.6M rows /
275 MB extrapolated at 305 sta x 3 h).
network.trace_station_residuals - the T3 cell population, so the census can be joined
against the cells it explains.
network.trace_ionosphere        - deliberately armed ABOVE its SCOPED '<= 50 sta'
guidance: a full extra reconstruct sweep is exactly
the cost this smoke exists to measure.  Grade
iono_total_m, NEVER iono_m.
network.trace_prefit_census     - RECOMMEND_ON tier, flagged as an in-regime gap by
scripts/config_posture_check.py.  7.6 ms/epoch (0.4%)
at 63 sta, solve byte-identical, and it shares ONE walk
with trace_topology.  Also in CLAUDE.md standard set.
network.trace_topology          - same walk, event-only (3.5 events/epoch); standing
invariant #7 - it is what makes a gate decouple/
re-couple edge visible at all.
NOT armed, and this is deliberate:
network.phase_anchor_carry_reref - QUEUE 1(d) is loader-DISABLED under the eq34 chain
datum (GnssConfigLoadNetwork.cpp:6750), which this
lineage runs.  eq34 already owns eq34_reref.  Arming
it here would be a no-op plus a warn, not a test.
network.raim_redundancy_normalize - measured NULL on the flag rate and +38% wall
(SPEC_t3_null_derivation section 5).  Falsified; the
census reports the same r_i without it.
